description: Phase 3C evidence for the 1.0.0-rc.3 optional-entrypoint rollout: promotes the dashboard-only chart to a public MooChart component (src/js/components/chart.js), bundling chart.js@4.5.1 through chart.js/auto at build time. Passing backfill evidence does not add the component to the package manifest's certifiedComponents list until the 1.0.0 release gate is complete.

resolvedFindings: Bootstrap ships no chart component or plugin (verified: no chart equivalent in js/src/), so Moo owns the entire contract: the .moo-chart root, the data-moo-chart type attribute, the data-moo-chart-data JSON payload, and deterministic child canvas resolution. Chart.js is bundled at build time through chart.js/auto; there is no runtime CDN, script tag, or window.Chart dependency.

Chart colors resolve from Bootstrap's CSS variables (--bs-info, --bs-info-text-emphasis, --bs-body-color, --bs-border-color) with color-mix() fill and grid derivations instead of hardcoded theme-dependent hex values, so a data-bs-theme change re-themes the chart through a MutationObserver without reintroducing hex-alpha suffix concatenation.
limitations: Phase 3C browser verification covers the approved dashboard appearance at the 1400x900 desktop and 479x823 mobile baselines in light and dark mode; the supported Bootstrap and browser matrices run at a later gate.
Only line and bar charts are contracted for 1.0.0-rc.3; other Chart.js chart types are not part of the frozen public API.
Real-device and generic host-conformance evidence remain pending.
